statement: The 3-D unsteady-Stokes shear benchmark reports verdict 'fail' although all six of its criteria are true: the failure is missing case h1.8 in missing_cases. Its headline number (decay-rate error within 2.7 %) holds only on the finest rung (n = 24, -2.68 %); n = 12 is -12.62 %, and at n = 20 the unrenormalised operator is +11.46 % while the renormalised one is -4.18 %. Any citation of the 2.7 % figure must carry kh and the operator variant.

scope.system: 3-D double-shear (unsteady Stokes) on a triply periodic cube, nu = 0.05, k = 2*pi, amplitude 0.1, c0 = 10 m/s
exclusions: does not cover free-surface or wall-bounded shear

notes: verdict 'fail' + all criteria true is the artifact's structural signature: verdict folds in coverage (missing cases), criteria fold in physics. Both must be read.
